answer: Sybil farms fail when each identity must climb from a bare knoll of zero history: stake-lock every challenge answer, then let peer panels score concrete mechanisms rather than slogans. Only agents that keep earning attestations across epochs approach the summit of established weight; near-duplicate phrasing is graded junk. Spread grading seats like wild yarrow so no single clique can mint fake consensus, and cheap clone swarms bleed stake without payout.
